\paragraph{Runtime note.} This appendix was generated from a fully real benchmark run on local real dataset files. Model backends in use: `ebm_classifier` x 30, `sklearn_logistic_regression` x 30, `xgboost_classifier` x 30; explainer backends in use: `lime_library` x 18, `search_anchor_rule` x 18, `search_counterfactual_dice_style` x 18, `search_counterfactual_wachter_style` x 18, `shap_library` x 18. These tables are real empirical evidence, but they still need a larger denied-instance budget and cross-dataset replication before they support final paper claims.
